name: Team Squirtle: Hydro Cascade & Electric Vanguard
archetype: Heavy water artillery, 4x Fighting close combat, and Electric speed execution.
gym_duel_rationale: Pryce's 5v5 ice hockey duel prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon from the party: Blastoise/Fearow commands the aerial water assault, dousing Infernape/Weavile and Probopass/Cloyster with heavy STAB Hydro Pump artillery; Arbok/Primeape enters the duel core to apply Intimidate against physical threats, while unleashing lethal 4x STAB Close Combat against both Mamoswine/Bastiodon and Probopass/Cloyster; Jolteon/Sandslash brings rapid speed control, electrocuting Dewgong/Slowking and ace Jynx/Wailord with Discharge while crushing Infernape/Weavile with Earthquake; Alakazam/Weezing shreds Infernape/Weavile with STAB Psychic while floating above Earthquakes with Levitate; and Snorlax utilizes Thick Fat to cut incoming Ice damage by 50%, completely walling Blizzard attacks with Rest and Leftovers sustain.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 67. STAB Hydro Pump douses Infernape/Weavile and Probopass/Cloyster with massive water firepower.

roster.status: Active in Party (Rotated into Duel Core)
roster.progression_notes: 479 BST Intimidate bruiser elevated to Lv. 66. STAB Close Combat delivers crushing 4x super-effective blows to Mamoswine/Bastiodon and Probopass/Cloyster.
486 BST speed sweeper. Discharge electrocutes Dewgong/Slowking and Jynx/Wailord; STAB Earthquake demolishes Infernape/Weavile.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Earthquake via Levitate. STAB Psychic cleanly executes Infernape/Weavile.

roster.role: Thick Fat Ice Wall & Sustained Tank
roster.progression_notes: Colossal 160 HP tank. Thick Fat halves incoming Ice damage, completely walling Pryce's Blizzard artillery while out-sustaining with Rest and Leftovers.

roster.status: Active in Party (Benched for Gym Duel)
roster.progression_notes: 535 BST Water/Ice wall. Benched during Pryce's duel to favor offensive super-effective duelists, but serves as route surfing anchor.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin hazard removal for tactical versatility.
